prompt_deltas.text: Her free left index fingertip taps the black ring once, gently, while her ringing hand rests on her knee. 0-1.2s: the left hand slides in from the upper right and the index fingertip presses the ring once. 1.2-2.4s: a very subtle small soft white glow, no larger than the ring itself, appears on the band and fades. 2.4-4.7s: the left hand withdraws out of frame and the ringed hand stays perfectly still. Vertical 9:16, one continuous shot, no cuts, starting exactly from the start frame. Camera locked off, no zoom, no drift. Nobody speaks; mouths stay closed. Ambient only: no sound. All text in the start frame stays exactly as it is, unchanged, fully visible and still for the entire clip, including the green pill. Do not add any text, captions, subtitles, logos or watermarks. Keep the ring, its display digits and logo exactly as in the start frame; digits sharp, ring does not rotate, no second ring. Keep her hand, sleeve, trousers, desk, laptop and window identical to the start frame; the background must not shift.

prompt_deltas.text: A fingertip taps the rose-gold ring and the display ticks from 0032 to 0033. 0-0.8s: the other hand's index fingertip presses the ring once. 0.8-1.6s: the display changes from 0032 to 0033 and a very faint thin rose-gold shimmer outlines the ring only, no larger than the ring. 1.6-3.8s: the fingertip lifts away out of frame and the hand holds perfectly still. Vertical 9:16, one continuous shot, no cuts, starting exactly from the start frame. Camera locked off or a barely perceptible 2 percent push-in. No face in frame. The green prayer mat, its border, the table and the wall stay completely unchanged: no smoke, glow, fire, stain, color wash or pattern change on the mat or anywhere outside the ring. Keep the ring, display, digits and logo exactly as in the start frame; the ring does not rotate. Keep the hand identical to the start frame. All text in the start frame stays exactly as it is, unchanged and still. Do not add any text, captions, subtitles, logos or watermarks.
